name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Place a sturdy bench behind the Smith bar and set the bar across your upper back with your front foot planted.
Rest your rear foot on the bench, check your balance and release the hooks.
Bend both knees and lower your rear knee toward the floor while keeping your front heel planted.
Drive firmly through your front foot to stand back up, rerack safely, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Place the front foot where you can balance over the whole foot throughout the descent.
Keep your hips square and torso upright rather than leaning heavily into your back foot.
